item.description:
Unison-UI-Mac 0.5.0

Version 0.5.0 adds in-app updates, so the app can find and install new versions on its own, and moves distribution to a Developer ID-signed, notarized build. It also adds a Software Updates settings tab and a Donate menu item. It builds on 0.4.2.

Existing profiles and settings continue to work without migration.

Added

  • In-app updates. The app can now check for updates and install them itself, through the Sparkle update framework. Use App menu ▸ Check for Updates at any time. On first launch the app asks whether to check automatically.
  • Software Updates settings. A new Updates tab in Settings lets you change these choices at any time: whether the app checks for updates automatically, and whether it includes an anonymous system profile when it checks.
  • Donate menu item. Help ▸ Donate opens the project's GitHub Sponsors page.

Changed

  • Signed and notarized distribution. The app is now distributed as a Developer ID-signed, notarized build, so it opens with a normal double-click. Updates after the first install come through the app itself.

Compatibility

  • No profile or settings migration is required. Same system requirements as 0.4.2 (macOS 15 or later, Apple Silicon).
  • If you installed an earlier version by hand, install 0.5.0 once (via Homebrew or the download); after that the app updates itself, automatically if you enable automatic checks or any time from App menu ▸ Check for Updates.
